title: Deep Root Haven

diffuser.notes: Add to diffuser before meditation; let aroma settle for 5 minutes.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; spray into air, not on skin.

why_it_works: Earthy vetiver and patchouli deepen the breath, while sweet orange adds a soft, reassuring warmth—supporting a grounded, centered meditation.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
